Goal: Open a new SAVINGS account funded from account 12345, and return the new account number

Values supplied to you:
  username = 'john'
  password = SECRET (use type_secret, you will not be shown it)

This re-records a capability that callers already use.
It takes these parameters:
  account_type
  funding_account
It returns these values, each named with `output_name` on a read:
  new_account_number

Use those exact names for the same values, so the callers keep working. Only add a new name if you find a value they do not cover.
